title: Tenma Saki — The Feelings We've Realized〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Excuse me♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh, Shiho, found you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki? Are you here to borrow a textbook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, silly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm actually here because Ichi's busy with committee stuff again and was wondering if you want to have lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You invited me last time, so I'm here to return the favor♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And you came all this way?
But... Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Yay!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You brought a lunch today, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I woke up pretty early to make this♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho, you brought lunch too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just for today. It's all just leftovers from last night...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
By the way, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Those omelets look really...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hands off.
I only have two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But...! Hang on...
How did you know what I was gonna ask?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was written all over your face. What's wrong with what you have? It looks really good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, but...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, no fair!
Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not giving you any.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it's not about your lunch...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I'm sorry about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The other day...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, for asking you to just believe in me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I understand that you were just looking out for me, but I was absolutely sure that I knew what I needed to do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, I'm really sorry for making you worry about me like that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Why are you apologizing?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because, well... For making it seem like I didn't trust you. I never meant for you to feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's okay, really. I get why you felt that way. I'm already a two-time loser when it comes to health, so I don't blame you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Two-time loser...?
That might be going a little too far.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But they're both way up there on my list of regrets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, did you just say, list of regrets...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a ranked list that I made to make sure I get to enjoy high school as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey... You laughed just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know you're completely serious about all this, but calling yourself a two-time loser and saying that you have an actual list of regrets was just too much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?
Well, anyways...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry about making you worry so much about me, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So again, I apologize.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still want to contribute to our band in some way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, you even said so yourself during lunch the other day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You find the things that you want to do and make sure you'll actually be able to do them, right? You've helped us so much already by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I believe you'll be the first one to figure out what kind of feelings we want to convey as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your words are what helped me figure out what I needed to do to write our song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So thank you for looking out for me all this time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All I did was tell you what was on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like you should be giving yourself more credit too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were the one who actually followed through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's true too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the real truth is writing that song reminded me of when I was still in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, it was because I didn't know where the goal was or how long it would take.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not having any idea how much actual progress I was making didn't help either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm here today because I didn't give up back there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And not giving up on this song made me believe that I'd be able to realize something I couldn't before!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once I knew that, I felt a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It also gave me a chance to think about what you meant by committing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew that trying to become a professional musician isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But actually trying to write my own song made me realize just how hard that really is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, I have a better understanding of what you meant compared to when we all decided to go down this path.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe not as much as you, Shiho, but I feel more committed to our music now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you definitely do seem more committed. What you did was really amazing, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So thank you.
We'll be counting on you from now on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You got it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you really never stop amazing me, Shiho! It's like you knew this would all happen even after we made our decision.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've seen a lot of bands come and go just by working at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you're still after my omelets, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? No, what are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have some yummy pumpkin croquettes here...! Wanna trade?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay... We can trade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Without further ado...!
Oh, I knew it! It's sooo good♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No talking when your mouth's full.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hokay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki...
